subject: Clearway console + API bootcamp — choose final session time
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@clearway.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearway bootcamp — time options

Hi Irene,

Thanks for sending the initial options. Elena and I ran this by the engineering leads and we have a couple of hard constraints: our infra team can only spare folks between 11:00–14:00 PT on weekdays next week, and the compliance lead needs a short slot on day 1 for an audit overview.

Can we lock into either:
- Tue Feb 16, 11:30–14:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Feb 17, 12:00–14:30 PT (fallback)

A couple of asks so we can prep:
- Please include a brief section on API key provisioning (we need step-by-step to hand to our ops team).
- Send sandbox access instructions at least 48 hours before.

Elena will be on copy for scheduling. If those times work we can confirm now and I’ll send calendar invites from my side.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Park
Head of Engineering
Clearway Health

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@clearway.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearway bootcamp — time options

Hi Sam — great, thanks for the constraints. Both Tue 11:30–14:00 PT and Wed 12:00–14:30 PT work for our trainers, but Tue is preferable on our side as it gives us an extra hour to stage the demo environment beforehand.

Quick plan and next steps:
- Proposed: Tue Feb 16, 11:30–14:00 PT (3-hour bootcamp; split: 60m console walkthrough, 75m hands-on API lab, 25m Q&A/next steps).
- Compliance overview: we’ll reserve the first 15 minutes for the compliance lead as requested.
- Deliverables I’m attaching: Redwood runbook v1 (high level agenda + day-of checklist) and sandbox access instructions.
- Action items for you: confirm Tue 11:30–14:00 PT and provide attendee list with emails (ops, infra, compliance).

Logistics notes for scheduling:
- I’ll create a single calendar invite with conferencing and attach the runbook. If Clearway prefers to send the invite from your domain, that’s fine — please include our trainer aliases (training@redwood.ai) when you send it.
- We’ll provision ephemeral API keys for the lab and share them in the sandbox instructions. Keys expire after 72 hours.

Attaching: redwood_runbook_v1.pdf; sandbox-access-instructions.txt; clearway-bootcamp.ics (calendar stub).

If anything changes on your side, let me know and we can pivot to Wed.

Best,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182

- Soojin: can you confirm who from CS will cover the post-bootcamp follow-up (access teardown, evals)?
